BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The data travels in the URL of a network request.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: The attacker needs access to logs, history or proxies where the URL is stored.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: Access to logs or shared systems usually requires an account.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: No user action is needed beyond normal use of the application.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Only data handled by the vulnerable application is exposed.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Passwords or other sensitive values are disclosed.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Reading the data does not change it.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
